full_judgment: 2. The present petitioners and the opposite parties 1, 2 and 6 and the predecessor of opposite party Nos. 3-5, as plaintiffs have filed Other Suit No. 182 of 1975 for declaration of their title and for further declaration that MRR Khatian prepared in the name of the defendants in respect of the suit land, is illegal and not binding upon the plaintiffs. Plaintiffs case briefly, may be stated that the suit land belonged to Musa Ali After death of Musa Ali his only son Gura Mia inherited the same. Plaintiffs are his heirs and they are in possession of the suit land. The MRR Khatian having been wrongly prepared in the name of the defendants, the plaintiffs' title has been clouded and hence the suit.
